# `/public-identities-config` endpoints

Base URL: `https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com`

### GET /public-identities-config/v1

`getPublicIdentityConfigV1` — Get the public identities configuration

Returns the publicly visible attributes of an identity available to request approvers for Access Requests and Certification Campaigns.

- Scopes: idn:public-identity-config:manage, idn:public-identity-config:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Returns 200: publicidentityconfig

### PUT /public-identities-config/v1

`updatePublicIdentityConfigV1` — Update the public identities configuration

Updates the publicly visible attributes of an identity available to request approvers for Access Requests and Certification Campaigns.

- Scopes: idn:public-identity-config:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Body (application/json): publicidentityconfig
- Returns 200: publicidentityconfig
